title: Optimal Regret for Online Storage Control via Cumulative Policies
summary: We study online control of a scalar storage system with adversarial nonnegative arrivals, known retention coefficient, and convex costs depending on both state and action. Each action must respect current resource availability and is chosen before the current arrival and cost function are revealed. For the existing simplex disturbance-action policy class, we give an exact reparameterization by cumulative allocation fractions and a decay-weighted projected subgradient update.
